statement: Given the exceptional comparison laws [def-sp-field-exceptional-system-laws], define the natural isomorphism $C_XG_E\cong G_FC_Y$ by taking as its forward components precisely the actual counit transpose components of [def-sp-field-exceptional-system-components], and the inverses supplied by their invertibility. Naturality is the naturality clause of the given laws. This introduces no independently chosen isomorphism.
